name: Galaxy Buds
author: Aislan Dener Souza Vicentini
description: Noise control for Samsung Galaxy Buds straight from the bar, with per-earbud battery, 360 Audio, touch controls and quick connect where the model supports them.

barWidget.description: Switch noise modes, watch per-earbud battery and charging, pick the Bluetooth codec, and toggle 360 Audio, touch controls and quick connect. Controls the model does not have are hidden.

schema.label: Label overrides
schema.description: Replace any visible string, e.g. {"anc": "ANC", "ambient": "Som ambiente"}. Keys: noiseControl, settings, codec, off, anc, ambient, adaptive, spatial, touch, seamless, left, right, case, notOutput, serviceOff, searchHint, searching, found, connectingDevice, search, pair.
